##### Project general facts

The Canopies Sanctuary is a residential neighbourhood by Aldar, set among landscaped parklands and planned around architecture and nature sharing the same space. Mid-rise buildings with curved, arched balconies frame a landscaped podium, while sculptural canopy structures shade garden paths, seating areas and outdoor spaces meant for everyday use. The residences include studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and a study. Gardens form the centre of the community, with dedicated places to exercise, work and meet neighbours.

Amenities are divided between the open-air podium and indoor spaces. For leisure, residents have a podium garden, swimming pools with sun loungers and pool cabanas, a canopy lounge and a table tennis area set among the planting. BBQ stations and outdoor dining areas, including an outdoor kitchen under a canopy, are arranged for gatherings. Families can use outdoor and indoor kids' play areas, and fitness is covered by an outdoor exercise area and a fully equipped gym. A residents' co-working lounge serves those who work from home, and lobby lounges have large windows facing the gardens.

Interiors use porcelain tiles on floors and in bathrooms, with painted walls and ceilings throughout. Kitchens have laminate upper and lower cabinets, engineered stone counters and a matching engineered stone backsplash. Bathrooms combine engineered stone vanities with laminate vanity fronts, glass shower partitions and gunmetal sanitaryware. Laminate doors and laminate wardrobe fronts complete the specification. Apartments come with fitted kitchens and built-in wardrobes, while loose furniture is not included and is left to the owner.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Point occupies the northern tip of Yas Island, an Abu Dhabi destination known for its theme parks, beaches, golf, marinas and entertainment venues. The area is defined by its waterfront: a long promenade follows the shore, an open-water beach is used for kayaking and windsurfing, and landscaped parks connect with walking and cycling routes. Water taxi access is available along the coast, and the setting has a relaxed, coastal character for both residents and visitors.

Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld Yas Island are a short trip away, and Yas Mall covers everyday shopping and dining. Yas Marina, Yas Marina Circuit, the Yas Links golf course, Etihad Arena and Topgolf add sport and entertainment options. For families, Yas American Academy and Noya British School are located on the island. Zayed International Airport, Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi Corniche and the city centre are within a short drive, and Dubai can be reached comfortably by road.

Yas Island is an investment zone where international buyers can own property, and its residential community keeps growing alongside rising visitor numbers. Waterfront homes at the northern end of the island are limited in supply, which strengthens their position within the Abu Dhabi market. Demand comes from families, working professionals and tenants, which supports both owner-occupation and rental income over the long term.
